title: Need
description: need information definition. Schema describes source data, not page layout.

what_we_are_seeing.description: Attributed observations and reported conditions in the public record; these are not necessarily Crossover's firsthand findings.

investigation_status.description: Crossover's investigative engagement with this need, not its severity, priority, condition trend, or solution outcome. Identified means the need is recorded; investigating means Crossover is actively examining it.

active.description: Publication eligibility for the current Need index and related public updates. It does not describe severity, investigation progress, or whether the underlying condition persists or improves.

visual_description.description: Optional subject or scene Crossover wants an independent renderer to understand; not alt text or evidence.

preferred_image.description: Optional preferred illustrative image path or URL; the renderer may use another image or none.

logo_description.description: Optional description of the record's authentic visual identity or symbol; not alt text.

preferred_logo.description: Optional preferred existing logo path or URL. Do not present an invented mark as an organization's official logo.

thumbnail_image.description: Optional thumbnail variant of the preferred image for compact displays.
